protocol.rubric: levels 1/2/3 = 8-10/4-7.9/1-3.9; score individual and overall, no averaging of contributions
protocol.reason_independent_repetition_incomplete: No isolated scoring agent or independent model call was executed.

baseline_compatibility.rationale: Direct consequence of disabling intervention with identical action kernel and randomness.

pressure_controller.rationale: Observable backlog and cost scheduling heuristic; no new optimal decision principle.

dual_budget_interface.rationale: Separates reward-core exploration from certification, preserves a service guarantee; central bounds follow from previously established any-action regret and finite-work inequalities.

guarded_tempered_sampling.rationale: New tested configuration improves most mean-regret comparisons, but tempered random sampling and optimism-based protection have strong precedents; no universal dominance or new tight rate.

no_zero_slack_example.rationale: A useful elementary decision-theoretic diagnostic, not a major new impossibility principle.

overall.rationale: Substantial implementation and application value, but remains a systematic extension of prior CCP; no new frontier characterization or nontrivial oracle-efficient allocation guarantee. The parent paper is not rescored here.

repeat_statistics.note: No repeat mean or variance reported; only one actual judgment.

main_limits: Strict universal no-worse goal is disproved for the named initialization conventions.
Main held-out pointwise means win in 59/60 pairs, but statistical no-inferiority is not established for all pairs.
Cold scores can worsen high-regret tails.
Same ALL cost controller required one audited post-test correction.
